reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Nebraska
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for statutory tenant obligations?
*/

/* =========================
   STATUTES (translated)
   ========================= */

/* --- NE Code  76-1421 (2021): tenant obligations to maintain dwelling unit --- */

% statute_76_1421_obligation(Obligation).
statute_76_1421_obligation(building_code_compliance_health_safety).              % 76-1421(1)
statute_76_1421_obligation(keep_premises_clean_and_safe).                       % 76-1421(2)
statute_76_1421_obligation(dispose_waste_clean_and_safe).                       % 76-1421(3)
statute_76_1421_obligation(keep_plumbing_clean).                                % 76-1421(4)
statute_76_1421_obligation(reasonable_use_of_facilities).                       % 76-1421(5)
statute_76_1421_obligation(no_damage_or_allow_damage).                          % 76-1421(6)
statute_76_1421_obligation(no_disturb_neighbors_peaceful_enjoyment).            % 76-1421(7)
statute_76_1421_obligation(abide_applicable_rules_not_inconsistent).            % 76-1421(8)

/* --- NE Code  76-1431 (2021): noncompliance / cure / termination rules --- */

% statute_76_1431_noncompliance_kind(Kind).
% Kinds used in this program.
statute_76_1431_noncompliance_kind(tenant_statutory_76_1421_health_safety). % 76-1431(1) referencing 76-1421 materially affecting health & safety
statute_76_1431_noncompliance_kind(material_rental_agreement_breach).        % 76-1431(1)
statute_76_1431_noncompliance_kind(nonpayment_of_rent).                      % 76-1431(2)
statute_76_1431_noncompliance_kind(violent_criminal_activity_or_drug_sale_or_threat). % 76-1431(4)

% statute_76_1431_cure_rule(Kind, NoticeMinDaysToTermination, CureDaysWithinNotice, CureAllowed).
% Encodes the cure structure described by  76-1431.
statute_76_1431_cure_rule(tenant_statutory_76_1421_health_safety, 30, 14, yes). %  76-1431(1)
statute_76_1431_cure_rule(material_rental_agreement_breach,        30, 14, yes). %  76-1431(1)
statute_76_1431_cure_rule(nonpayment_of_rent,                       0,  7, yes). %  76-1431(2) (termination after notice if unpaid within 7 calendar days)
statute_76_1431_cure_rule(violent_criminal_activity_or_drug_sale_or_threat, 5, 0, no). %  76-1431(4) "without the right of the tenant to cure"

% statute_76_1431_same_breach_recurrence_within_six_months_allows_termination(yes/no).
%  76-1431(1) second sentence: recurrence within 6 months after prior notice can allow termination on 14 days' notice.
statute_76_1431_same_breach_recurrence_within_six_months_allows_termination(yes).

/* =========================
   SCENARIO (facts)
   ========================= */

% scenario metadata
scenario_state(nebraska).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Parties and tenancy (minimal identifiers)
scenario_landlord(landlord1).
scenario_tenant(tenant1).
scenario_rental_agreement(lease1).

% The question's scenario is encoded as:
% - tenant has a statutory tenant obligation issue (76-1421) materially affecting health and safety
% - landlord delivered the  76-1431(1) notice (>=30 days to termination, 14-day cure)
% - breach is remediable
% - tenant adequately remedies within the allowed cure period (an "attempt to cure" that is adequate)
% - not a recurrence within 6 months
% - not violent criminal activity (no-cure subsection)
scenario_breach_kind(tenant_statutory_76_1421_health_safety).
scenario_breach_obligation(keep_premises_clean_and_safe).
scenario_breach_materially_affecting_health_or_safety(yes).
scenario_breach_remediable(yes).
scenario_tenant_adequately_remedied(yes).

% Notice timing modeled in days from receipt (receipt = day 0)
scenario_notice_received_day(0).
scenario_notice_specified_termination_day(30).  % "not less than thirty days after receipt" ( 76-1431(1))
scenario_tenant_cure_day(10).                   % within 14 days and before termination day

% Recurrence facts
scenario_same_breach_recurred_within_six_months(no).

% Violent criminal activity / drugs / threats facts
scenario_violent_criminal_activity_or_drug_sale_or_threat(no).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the factual statement (as encoded) holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(nebraska),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(landlord1),
    scenario_tenant(tenant1),
    scenario_rental_agreement(lease1),
    scenario_breach_kind(tenant_statutory_76_1421_health_safety),
    scenario_breach_obligation(Obl),
    statute_76_1421_obligation(Obl),
    scenario_breach_materially_affecting_health_or_safety(yes),
    scenario_breach_remediable(yes),
    scenario_tenant_adequately_remedied(yes),
    scenario_notice_received_day(ReceiptDay),
    scenario_notice_specified_termination_day(TermDay),
    integer(ReceiptDay),
    integer(TermDay),
    TermDay >= ReceiptDay,
    scenario_tenant_cure_day(CureDay),
    integer(CureDay),
    CureDay >= ReceiptDay,
    scenario_same_breach_recurred_within_six_months(no),
    scenario_violent_criminal_activity_or_drug_sale_or_threat(no).

/* =========================
   REASONING (apply statutes)
   ========================= */

% legal_no_cure_applies/0:  76-1431(4) no-right-to-cure pathway applies.
legal_no_cure_applies :-
    scenario_violent_criminal_activity_or_drug_sale_or_threat(yes),
    % Under  76-1431(4), cure is not available (subject to  76-1431(5) exceptions, not modeled here because scenario says "no").
    !.

legal_no_cure_applies :-
    scenario_violent_criminal_activity_or_drug_sale_or_threat(no),
    fail.

% legal_tenant_has_right_to_cure/0: tenant has a right to cure under the applicable  76-1431 subsection.
legal_tenant_has_right_to_cure :-
    \+ legal_no_cure_applies,
    scenario_breach_kind(Kind),
    statute_76_1431_cure_rule(Kind, _NoticeMinDaysToTermination, _CureDaysWithinNotice, yes),
    !.

legal_tenant_has_right_to_cure :-
    fail.

% legal_cure_is_timely_and_effective/0: the tenant adequately cured within the statutory cure window for  76-1431(1)-type breaches.
legal_cure_is_timely_and_effective :-
    legal_tenant_has_right_to_cure,
    scenario_breach_kind(Kind),
    statute_76_1431_cure_rule(Kind, _NoticeMinDaysToTermination, CureDaysWithinNotice, yes),
    scenario_breach_remediable(yes),
    scenario_tenant_adequately_remedied(yes),
    scenario_notice_received_day(ReceiptDay),
    scenario_tenant_cure_day(CureDay),
    scenario_notice_specified_termination_day(TermDay),
    % For  76-1431(1): breach not remedied in 14 days leads to termination on the specified date.
    % We require cure within the cure window and before the termination date specified in the notice.
    CureDay =< ReceiptDay + CureDaysWithinNotice,
    CureDay < TermDay,
    scenario_same_breach_recurred_within_six_months(no),
    !.

legal_cure_is_timely_and_effective :-
    fail.

% legal_landlord_must_accept_cure/0:
% If the breach is remediable and tenant adequately remedies within the statutory cure period,
% then under  76-1431(1) "the rental agreement will not terminate" (so landlord must accept cure / cannot terminate on that basis).
legal_landlord_must_accept_cure :-
    legal_cure_is_timely_and_effective,
    !.

legal_landlord_must_accept_cure :-
    fail.

/* =========================
   ANSWER
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_landlord_must_accept_cure,
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ legal_landlord_must_accept_cure,
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    % If the scenario facts weren't satisfied, default to "no" rather than guessing.
    \+ scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   MAIN
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for statutory tenant obligations?
